items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: we had Sonny Henry on Trimboine

ctx.x: Well, I have to try to find him. And they had, uh, Rene was on trumpet. Mealy Hawkins was on trumpet. They had another fella named Joe, I can't call his last name. He was, I had three trumpets. Can't call this other Joe's name. Was it Joe Phillips or something? No, a little short, bright fella. No, I don't know. Well, we had, we had Sonny Henry on Trimboine. He'll play with the Eureka now. Yeah, and we had Joe Abram on Trimboine.
Yeah, he died, you know, a couple years ago. Yeah.
